name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Safari Skewer (Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus — Eat Tips Only Mod)
whyItWorks: A cult-favorite Disneyland snack that is gluten-free and dairy-free, though smoky bacon fat and fibrous lower asparagus stalks mean you should only eat the tender top tips in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bite off the soft upper asparagus tips with the bacon and discard any woody, stringy lower asparagus stems.
watchOuts: Woody lower asparagus stalks are high in insoluble fiber; stick to Chicken or Beef skewers during active flares
